subject: ACME MAP: POC environment setup dependencies
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Peters <sam.peters@acme.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: ACME MAP: POC environment setup dependencies

Hi Sam -

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the POC environment setup milestones. I captured the items we flagged as blockers for getting the POC environment runnable in your VPC: VPC peering, IP allowlists, SSO/SAML, and customer-managed secrets/KMS access.

High-level ask: please confirm the owners on your side for network and security items so we can lock milestones and a target date for POC readiness. Proposed target close for the POC environment milestone: 2026-03-15 (we'll adjust if your timelines differ).

Summary of MAP milestones (draft):
- Network: VPC peering + route update (owner: ACME network) - dependency: ACME VPC CIDR & peer account ID
- Network: IP allowlist for Redwood Egress IPs (owner: ACME network) - dependency: final list of egress IPs
- Identity: SSO/SAML integration & test user setup (owner: ACME identity) - dependency: IdP metadata + test account
- Secrets: Customer KMS key + limited access role for Redwood (owner: ACME security) - dependency: KMS key ARN + KMS policy
- Redwood tasks: VPC peering acceptance, config of routing and SGs, SAML SP config, KMS role binding (owner: Redwood SRE/Onboarding)

Attachments: ACME_MAP_DRAFT_v1.pdf (MAP including milestone table) and acme-network-diagram.png (example network flows).

Next steps:
1) Please reply with internal owners + any date constraints by end of week.
2) If helpful, Nikhil (cc'd) can schedule a 30-min tech alignment with your network/security leads.

Thanks - look forward to locking this down.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

---
From: Sam Peters <sam.peters@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jia Chen <jia.chen@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACME MAP: POC environment setup dependencies

Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP. We're aligned on the items you listed. A few notes from our side:

- Network: I'll loop in our network lead, Jia Chen (cc'd). She'll confirm the VPC CIDR and the account ID we should peer with. Expect that after our internal change window next week.
- IP allowlist: we will need the full egress IP list from Redwood; can you confirm whether these are static for the POC?
- SSO/SAML: Our identity team needs the SP metadata and expected attribute mappings. We can prioritize this but will likely need 1-2 weeks to complete on our side.
- KMS/secrets: Security will need a short KMS policy template for the limited role you mentioned. We'll generate the key and share the ARN once approved.

Target date of 2026-03-15 is optimistic but reasonable if network and identity can prioritize. We'll try to meet it, otherwise we'll update ASAP.

Also confirm whether any of Redwood's configs require changes to our subnet route tables or just security groups and peering routes.

Thanks - Sam
Sam Peters
Director, Cloud Platform | ACME Corp
sam.peters@acme.com

On Wed, Feb 18, 2026 at 09:15 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Sam -
> 
> Thanks again for the call this morning....
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Peters <sam.peters@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: ACME MAP: POC environment setup dependencies

Hi Sam / Marissa -

Thanks Sam. Quick technical clarifications from our SRE/Onboarding side:

- Egress IPs: For the Dedicated/POC route we can provide a short list of stable egress IPs (these are static for the duration of the POC) - I'll attach the list and include them in the updated MAP.
- Routing: We only require VPC peering plus route table entries to point traffic to the peered CIDR. No changes to your subnet CIDRs are needed. Security groups on our side will be tightened to only accept connections from ACME CIDRs.
- SAML: We'll provide SP metadata.xml and an attribute map (email, name, groups). For testing, please create one test user (email + 2FA off if possible) and let us know the IdP metadata endpoint.
- KMS: We need a KMS key ARN and an IAM role that trusts Redwood's account id for the POC. We will provide a minimal KMS policy snippet you can drop into your policy if helpful.

Proposed owners & ETA (updated MAP lines):
- ACME network (owner: Jia Chen) - VPC CIDR + peering info needed by 2026-02-26
- ACME identity (owner: Jia Chen / identity team) - IdP metadata & test user by 2026-03-01
- ACME security (owner: security@acme.com) - KMS key ARN & policy by 2026-03-05
- Redwood SRE (owner: Nikhil) - accept peering, configure routes, smoke test by 2026-03-08

I attached a simple network diagram that shows the peering flow and the ports we need open (acme-network-diagram.png).

If those dates work, I'll update the MAP and share a JIRA/Tasks list we can both reference. Happy to hop on a 30-min tech sync next Tue/Thu - Marissa, can you propose times?

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai

Sam -

Perfect - thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping Jia. We've updated the MAP with Nikhil's dates and owners and attached the revision (ACME_MAP_DRAFT_v1.pdf). Here's the agreed next steps:

1) Jia / ACME network to send VPC CIDR + peer account ID by 2026-02-26.
2) ACME identity to share IdP metadata & create one test user by 2026-03-01.
3) ACME security to provide KMS ARN + policy by 2026-03-05.
4) Redwood SRE (Nikhil) to accept peering and run smoke tests by 2026-03-08.

I'll also create the shared JIRA board and invite the ACME tech contacts - link to the MAP is here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-ACME-MAP-DRAFT.

If anything shifts on your side, flag us and we'll reprioritize. Otherwise, we'll plan a 30-min tech sync for Tue, Mar 2 at 10am PT - Nikhil, please confirm availability.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
